newsitem.title: USA: Amer Eagle sees rating cut reducing business.
newsitem.headline: Amer Eagle sees rating cut reducing business.

text.p: American Eagle Group Inc said Wednesday it expects the action of A.M. Best Co, which lowered the rating of its principal subsidiary American Eagle Insurance Co to "D" from Vulnerable "B," to reduce the amount of business it produces in the near term, until regulatory filings are completed.

The company said the rating cut will substantially reduce the amount of business it directly writes for its own account in the future but will increase the amount of business that the company assumes from other companies that provide "A" rated policies.

Yesterday A.M. Best said its action reflected the view that American Eagle's weakened financial condition makes it "extremely vulnerable" to unfavorable changes in underwriting or economic conditions.
